cells.value: Under Minnesota Statutes 204C.05, subd. 1a, many towns may choose to open their polling place later than the normal opening time of 7:00 a.m. Town polling places that open later are listed below, with the opening time. Opening times will be the same for the 8/11/26 state primary and 11/3/26 state general election unless noted. Towns that are mail ballot precincts are not included. Last updated 7/28/26.
